title: Scheduled coverage
paraphrase: Specified chapters cover First Schedule areas.
notes: Conditional on section 2 coverage; presence in this library does not establish applicability.

title: Ownership exclusions
paraphrase: Government, local-authority, religious, charitable and Wakf premises are excluded.
notes: Conditional on section 2 coverage; presence in this library does not establish applicability.

title: Cooperative buildings
paraphrase: Cooperative-society buildings are excluded.
notes: Conditional on section 2 coverage; presence in this library does not establish applicability.

title: Statutory rent exclusion
paraphrase: Statutory rent thresholds: Part A INR 3500; elsewhere INR 2000.
notes: Use deemed rent at commencement or standard rent, not current market rent. Equality at the threshold is not an exclusion.

title: Construction exclusion
paraphrase: Construction or substantial renovation triggers fifteen years of exclusion.
notes: Conditional on section 2 coverage; presence in this library does not establish applicability.

title: Non-residential exclusion
paraphrase: Non-residential exclusion has a commercial-premises exception up to fourteen square metres.
notes: Conditional on section 2 coverage; presence in this library does not establish applicability.

title: Corporation areas
paraphrase: Corporation cities and their three-kilometre surroundings.
notes: Conditional on section 2 coverage; presence in this library does not establish applicability.

title: Council areas
paraphrase: City Municipal Council areas.
notes: Conditional on section 2 coverage; presence in this library does not establish applicability.

title: Court definition
paraphrase: Bangalore's defined Court is the Court of Small Causes.
notes: This defines Court under this Act; it does not establish a civil money-recovery pecuniary limit.

title: Written tenancy
paraphrase: Covered tenancies require written agreements.
notes: Conditional on section 2 coverage; presence in this library does not establish applicability.

title: Refund
paraphrase: Contravening payments: Controller refund application within one year.
notes: Conditional on section 2 coverage; presence in this library does not establish applicability.

title: Rent receipts
paraphrase: Receipts required; refusal can attract damages up to double payment.
notes: Conditional on section 2 coverage; presence in this library does not establish applicability.

title: Inspection notice
paraphrase: Inspection follows prescribed notice.
notes: Conditional on section 2 coverage; presence in this library does not establish applicability.

title: Handover condition
paraphrase: Normal wear and tear excepted at handover.
notes: Conditional on section 2 coverage; presence in this library does not establish applicability.

title: Essential services
paraphrase: Essential-service withdrawal requires just and sufficient cause.
notes: Conditional on section 2 coverage; presence in this library does not establish applicability.

title: Default notice
paraphrase: Absent contrary contract, law or usage, ordinary leases default to monthly duration and fifteen days' notice.
notes: Read with the agreement and applicable local law; this entry does not adjudicate a particular tenancy.

title: Registered leases
paraphrase: Yearly leases, terms exceeding one year and yearly-rent leases require registration.
notes: Read with the agreement and applicable local law; this entry does not adjudicate a particular tenancy.

title: Lease duties
paraphrase: Default rights and duties yield to contrary contract or local usage.
notes: Read with the agreement and applicable local law; this entry does not adjudicate a particular tenancy.

title: Material defects
paraphrase: Lessor discloses known latent material defects.
notes: Read with the agreement and applicable local law; this entry does not adjudicate a particular tenancy.

title: Quiet enjoyment
paraphrase: Performing tenants receive contractual quiet enjoyment.
notes: Read with the agreement and applicable local law; this entry does not adjudicate a particular tenancy.

title: Wear and tear
paraphrase: Restoration duty excepts reasonable wear and tear and irresistible force.
notes: Read with the agreement and applicable local law; this entry does not adjudicate a particular tenancy.

title: Penalty and compensation
paraphrase: A stipulated penalty supports only reasonable compensation, no greater than the stipulated amount.
notes: A risk flag is not a conclusion that every forfeiture is invalid; facts and judicial assessment matter.

title: Compulsory registration of leases
paraphrase: Yearly leases, terms exceeding one year and leases reserving yearly rent require registration.
notes: An eleven-month term alone does not resolve all registration or stamp-duty requirements.

title: Model residential deposit cap
paraphrase: The model proposes a two-month residential security deposit cap.
notes: Model provision only; not binding Karnataka law. Never cite as an applicable cap or available Karnataka authority.

title: Model Rent Authority
paraphrase: The model proposes appointment of a Rent Authority.
notes: Model provision only; not binding Karnataka law. Never cite as an applicable cap or available Karnataka authority.
